name: La Vega (Cauca, Colombia)
description: Bright green field with a light blue diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of La Vega, a municipality in the department of Cauca, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
